title: Implement Authentication and Authorization
problem_statement: FastAPI services lack authentication mechanisms, creating security vulnerabilities for the modernization platform
risk_if_unaddressed: Unauthorized access to modernization tools and sensitive legacy code analysis data
suggested_approach: Implement JWT-based authentication with role-based access control for agent operations and API endpoints
success_criteria: All FastAPI endpoints require valid authentication tokens
Role-based permissions for different agent operations
Audit logging for all authenticated operations

provenance.evidence: No authentication decorators or middleware detected

title: Refactor Analyst Agent Dependencies
problem_statement: Analyst agent has excessive import complexity (25 imports) indicating potential architectural violations and maintenance burden
risk_if_unaddressed: Increased maintenance cost, reduced testability, and potential circular dependency issues
suggested_approach: Apply dependency injection and interface segregation to reduce direct dependencies and improve modularity
success_criteria: Reduce analyst agent imports to under 15
Maintain functional parity with legacy behavior

provenance.evidence: 25 imports significantly exceeds other agents (4-14 range)

title: Implement Persistent Data Storage
problem_statement: JSON file-based team data storage lacks ACID properties and concurrent access safety
risk_if_unaddressed: Data corruption, lost work items, and inconsistent agent state during concurrent operations
suggested_approach: Migrate to PostgreSQL with proper transaction handling and connection pooling
success_criteria: All team data operations use ACID-compliant transactions
Concurrent access safety verified through testing
Data migration path preserves existing team configurations

provenance.evidence: Multiple JSON files without transaction coordination

title: Establish Comprehensive Testing Infrastructure
problem_statement: No visible test files or testing infrastructure despite having a dedicated tester agent
risk_if_unaddressed: Quality regressions, unreliable modernization outputs, and reduced confidence in agent behavior
suggested_approach: Implement pytest-based testing with agent behavior verification and integration tests
success_criteria: Unit tests for all agent interfaces
Integration tests for agent orchestration workflows

provenance.evidence: Tester agent exists but no test files detected in repository

title: Implement Agent Communication Monitoring
problem_statement: Complex agent orchestration (1038 import edges) lacks visibility into inter-agent communication and error propagation
risk_if_unaddressed: Difficult debugging, unpredictable agent failures, and reduced system observability
suggested_approach: Add structured logging and metrics collection for agent interactions and execution flows
success_criteria: All agent communications logged with correlation IDs
Performance metrics for agent execution times
Error tracking and alerting for agent failures

provenance.evidence: High import complexity without visible monitoring infrastructure
